repos_data.description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, and Pi
"Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"

Orkas is an open-source (MIT), local-first AI team for your desktop: a Commander turns your goal into to-dos and coordinates 16 built-in specialist agents plus Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes, with projects, scheduled automations and connectors. Free app for macOS & Windows; built-in models or your own keys.
AI Multi-Agent Framework in .NET

You're the boss, agents are your team. They handle tasks on their own, message each other, and review each other's work. You just watch the kanban board and give high-level commands. Codex/Claude/OpenCode/Cursor/Grok/GitHub/Kiro/Z.AI/Xiaomi/MiniMax/Kimi(300+ models, 200+ LLM providers, free models no auth) Build your AI company with multiple teams

Autonomous software factory. Give it a GitHub issue, a spec or a one-line task; get back a pull request with a signed receipt anyone can re-check offline. Runs on your machine with your own keys: Claude, Codex, OpenCode.

Lightweight AI agent runtime for Go. Define multi-agent crews in YAML, run them with goroutines and channels, and let the runtime handle scheduling, parallelism, retries, and observability — without leaving the Go ecosystem.

A control room for AI memory. Your files and conversations become searchable memory any model you connect can draw on, and you decide what enters, what moves and what leaves. Vaults live on your hardware. Windows, macOS, Linux.

A service-boundary-aware document exchange center for coordinating heterogeneous LLM code agents via MCP. Implements versioned Markdown store, pub-sub notifications, and diff-aware update protocol.
